method.note: sets A/B: each task file holds only the functions the task needs, so whole-file and scoped views are close in size

tokenizerNote: setup/view/output token counts are local js-tiktoken counts (OpenAI encodings), not the vendor tokenizer; providerUsage carries the billed counts when live.

design.setupCounted: A0 cells carry MODEL_GUIDE.txt as language instructions; TS and Rust cells carry a u32 semantics note; all carry their protocol instructions. design.unknowns: Hidden reasoning tokens are not reported by the API and are recorded as null.
